<!-- head-1: body_md -->
With probability at least
  $e^{-\gamma^{c'}L}$, the diagonalizing unitary $U$ is quasi-local: any operator
  supported in an interval $I$ has $UOU^\dagger=\sum_n O_n$ with $O_n$ supported
  in the $n$-neighbourhood of $I$ and $\|O_n\|\le \gamma^{cn}\|O\|$.
\item
<!-- end head-1 -->
<!-- head-2: body_md -->
The time-averaged heat
  current obeys $|\langle J^{(L)}\rangle_{\rm ne}|\le C L^{-\frac{c}{5}\log(1/\gamma)}$
  with probability $1-\exp(-L^{1-\gamma^{c'}}/\log L)$, so that
  $\lim_{L\to\infty}\mathbb{E}\,(L\langle J^{(L)}\rangle_{\rm ne})=0$.
\end{itemize}
<!-- end head-2 -->
